text:
Alex: Morning — quick async standup from me. Did a capacity sweep for APAC, noticed apac-west spot pool headroom down ~15% vs baseline after two AZ evictions overnight. Likely cause: model-rollout surge + some retained prewarm instances.
Maria: Yep saw the same in the dashboards. I traced a weird ASG scaling policy that prevented fallback to on-demand in az-b. Patch ready to reopen the fallback flag.
Sam: Thx. Is this the same rollout that started at 02:10? If so we should throttle concurrency on that rollout until quota is confirmed.
Alex: Yes, rollout id model-tilt-2026-03-15 started 02:10. I throttled canary to 10% but there were concurrent warmup jobs.
Jin: Blocker for me: provisioning requests for additional r5-gpu nodes in apac-west are pending cloud quota approvals. Ticket CLOUD-3421 is open but needs exec approval to fast-track. Anyone with quota contacts?
Maria: I can ping our cloud rep @yana. Will add CLOUD-3421 to the thread and ask for a 24h escalation.
Sam: Meanwhile, can we reduce non-critical prewarm? Suggest to toggle prewarm: {"model_type":"embedding","prewarm":false} for low-priority models. Small script: ```bash
# disable prewarm for embeddings low-prio
./infractl prewarm set --region apac-west --label embedding --enabled false
```
Alex: Good call. I pushed that change to staging and it dropped warm instances by ~8% in 20m. Rolling to prod in 5.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: canary-2026-03-15-apac-west by Alex — health ok, replica count 2 -> 1 prewarm reduced.
Maria: After patch, ASG fallback to on-demand works in az-b. Verified by forcing a spot eviction in staging (simulated). No service impact.
Jin: Great. Action items: 1) Maria to escalate CLOUD-3421 to cloud rep (thanks) 2) Alex to finish prod prewarm toggle rollout 3) Sam to throttle any ongoing rollouts until quota confirmed.
Sam: I’ll put a hold on new rollouts and message the release owners.
Alex: FYI I moved model-tilt canary back to 5% and killed excess warmers. Will monitor token latency for 30m.
Maria: Escalation sent to yana + cc procurement. Added estimate: need +6 r5-gpu (2 AZ spread) to restore baseline.
Jin: If quota takes >24h we should enable cross-region fallback to apac-east temporarily — is patch ready?
Alex: I have the routing policy change ready in repo: ```yaml
routing:
  region_fallback: true
  fallback_order: [apac-west, apac-east, eu-west]
``` Deploying after we see stability for 15m.
Sam: Sounds good. No further blockers from my side.
Alex: Thanks — I'll post a short update in #incidents if things degrade. :thumbsup:
